genomad.sole_hallmark_description: Site-specific DNA recombinase related to the DNA invertase Pin

scientific_reason: Predominantly cellular markers and a sole recombinase hallmark do not establish that the full196kb contig is a viral genome. No delimited viral interval or capsid/packaging hallmark has been established by inspected output. Retain as unresolved; do not infer an excised or active virus, and do not treat unresolved as negative control. Manual decision applies to this target, not an invented global gene-ratio threshold.
